This answers the view known as Denial of the return and judgement, which held that christ will not come again, and there will be no judgement of the living and the dead. The Church rejected that view (Excluded by 'he shall come again, with glory, to judge'). See Acts 1:11: "who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”"
rejected: Christ will not come again, and there will be no judgement of the living and the dead. That is the most reasonable reading, and Christians are free to believe it.
